lines.text: Leo loved building block castles, racing cars, and drawing monsters!
When playtime ended, he left all his toys scattered across the floor!
At bedtime, his favorite cuddly teddy bear was nowhere to be found!
He searched under toy mountains, tripping over plastic bricks and cars!
Ouch! Stepping on scattered toys hurts little feet and breaks things!
Leo turned on the tidy-up music and raced to put toys into their colorful bins!
And there at the very bottom was teddy, smiling safe and sound!
Cleaning up your toys keeps your room safe and your treasures protected!
Tidy up with a smile and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
